main_text.p: cum Præpositione עַל. Præter. שָׁשְׁמָם Qui desolatus est, Thren.5.18. שָׁמְמוּ עָלֶיךָ Obstupuerunt super te, Iesa.52.14. Infin. Propter שְׁמוֹת וּשְׁאֵף desolare & exhaurire, Ezech.36.v.3. Similem formam vide in חָנַן. Fut. יֵשָּׁם Desolabo, Iesa.42.14. Similem formam vide in קָבַב. Niph. Præt. נְשַׁמּוּ מְסִלּוֹת Desolatæ sunt viæ, Iesa.33.8. Obstupescunt, Jerem.4.9. Pih.Partic. מְשׁוֹמֵם וְאֵשְׁבָה Et sedi stupens, Esr.9.3. Desolans, Dan.9.27. Hiph.Præter. הִשְׁמוּתָ De-folasti, Job.16.7. Particip. מְשַׁמִּים Stupens, Ezech.3.15. Infinit. הַשְּׁמֵם Desolando, Mich.6.13. Imperat. הִשָּׁמּוּ Stupore corripiamini, Job.21.5. intransitive, ut in Participio: Futur. יִשִּׁים Desolet, Jer.49.20. cum vocali brevi & Dagesch loco vocalis longæ, ut ante: Aliud hujus formæ vide in יִשֵּׁם. Hoph.Infin. הָשָּׁמָה Desolari ejus, id est, Desolationis; & ה in fine intelligitur habere Mappik, 2.Pa-ral.36.21.Lev.26.34. בְּהִשָּׁמָה מֵהֶם Dum esset desolata illius, pro בָּה transpositis punctis, v.43. Hithp.Fut. וְנִשְׁתּוֹמֵם Et obstupescebam, Dan.8.27. תִּשּׁוֹמֵם Desolationem accer-ses tibi? Eccl.7.17. quod habet formam ex Niphal & Hith-pahel compositam, aut plane est ex Niphal, ut Aben Esra vult, & Cholem est loco Kametz. Chald.Præt. אִשְׁתּוֹמֵם Obstupui, Dan.4.16.

שׁם vn. Desolans, Desolatum, Stupendum, Dan.8.13. & 12.11. עַל שֹׁמֵם Super desolatum, Dan.9.27. Plural. שׁוֹמְמִים Desolati, Thren.1.v.16. Et in ג שׁוֹמְמִין verf.4. Fœm. שׁוֹמְמָה Desolata, Jesa.54.1. Plur. נְחָלוֹת שְׁמָמוֹת Possessiones desolatæ, Jesa.49.8. Constr. שְׁמָמוֹת Jes.6.14. Aff. שִׁמְמוֹתֵינוּ Desolationes nostras, Dan.9.18.
שְׁמָמוֹת f. Idem, Ezech.35.v.7. Plural. שְׁמָמוֹת verf.9. Et ם cum simplici Scheva, לִשְׁמְמוֹת In desolationes, Jerem.25.12.

page.notes: Hebrew vowel points and some letters are hard to make out at this scan resolution, so the Hebrew forms are the best reading and may contain errors. The Hebrew running head and the signature "Fff 4" are as printed. A few Latin abbreviations (for example "Esr.", "Pih.", "Partic.") are read as printed.
